provenance: Owned procedural 16x12 grayscale sample fixture. Opened in Adobe Photoshop 2026, converted from Gray16 to Gray32 using the native Image > Mode command, then saved as PSD. No Adobe implementation code, plug-in SDK, or proprietary input content was used.
reason: Independent interoperable Gray32 PSD, including the 110-byte hdrt color-mode block. Before checkpoint511, the native Gray32 exporter emitted an empty color-mode block and Photoshop rejected the file.
